wording: Does your company have a written policy that covers labour rights and fair working conditions for all employees?
effort_caveat: People boolean sample: labour policy existence is ordinarily known to management.

wording: On average, how many hours per week does a full-time employee at your company work?
effort_caveat: Typical weekly hours for a full-time employee are normally known from standard schedules; variable overtime may require records.

wording: Does your company publish a sustainability or ESG report (even informally, such as a summary for clients or stakeholders)?
effort_caveat: Includes any external sustainability summary or ESG report.

wording: Does your company publish a sustainability or ESG report aligned with a recognised framework (e.g. GRI, ISSB, SASB)?
effort_caveat: Recognised framework means GRI, ISSB, SASB or similar.

wording: Has your company made a public commitment to fight corruption and bribery in all your business activities?
effort_caveat: Includes any formal public statement or policy.

wording: Does your company use due diligence to identify negative sustainability impacts in your supply chain or operations?
effort_caveat: Question asks about having an approach, not its results.

wording: Are your Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions verified by an independent third party?
effort_caveat: Asks whether emissions receive third-party verification, not for emissions totals; assume manager knows verification scope.

wording: Does your company hold third-party certified animal-welfare standards for its operations?
effort_caveat: Refers to third-party certified standards, if any.

wording: Does your company track the survival or health rate of farmed animals or aquatic species in your operations?
effort_caveat: Asks whether animal health is tracked, not for a rate; operational management normally knows the monitoring practice.

wording: Does your company consider environmental criteria when selecting or evaluating suppliers?
effort_caveat: Environmental criteria may be informal or formal.

wording: Does your company support women-owned businesses or promote inclusive procurement in its supplier relationships?
effort_caveat: Any support for women-owned businesses counts.

wording: Does your company run or support a formal community investment, philanthropy, or local-impact programme?
effort_caveat: Community boolean sample: running or supporting a formal programme is ordinary management knowledge.

wording: Do your farming or aquaculture operations follow a biodiversity or ecosystem-management approach (e.g. preventing escapes of farmed species)?
effort_caveat: Includes escape-prevention or similar practices.

wording: Does your company measure or estimate greenhouse-gas emissions that come directly from your own operations  -  for example from company vehicles, boilers, or on-site processes (sometimes called Scope 1 emissions)?
effort_caveat: Resources categorical sample: question asks whether Scope 1 is measured, not for a calculated emissions total.

wording: Does your company measure or estimate greenhouse-gas emissions from the electricity or heat it purchases from external suppliers (sometimes called Scope 2 emissions)?
effort_caveat: Includes estimated or calculated Scope 2 emissions.

wording: Does your company report direct (Scope 1) GHG emissions from agricultural activities (livestock, manure, fertiliser, on-farm fuel)?
effort_caveat: Includes livestock, manure, fertilizer, and on-farm fuel.

wording: Does your company report indirect GHG emissions from purchased energy used in food production or processing (Scope 2)?
effort_caveat: Includes purchased energy for production or processing.

wording: Does your company track the total amount of waste it generates?
effort_caveat: Tracking may be partial or full.

wording: Does your company have a plan to reduce the use of non-renewable or hazardous materials in its products or processes?
effort_caveat: Plan may be formal or informal.

wording: Does your company actively identify non-renewable materials in its production and work to reduce them?
effort_caveat: Question asks whether the company actively does this.
